model.name: R19.76: Replace playerToken-in-URL with short-lived preview nonce for file content auth.
model.description: SECURITY DEBT (NOT blocking MVP): R19.75 passes playerToken in the content URL query param (?token=) which exposes the long-lived auth credential in server access logs and browser history (same-origin, low but real risk). HARDEN: the server issues a short-lived (60s TTL) preview NONCE on request; the client appends the nonce instead of the playerToken to the content URL. The nonce is single-use or time-limited, scoped to the specific file UUID + room. This eliminates token leakage via URL while preserving R19.68 room-scoped auth.

discoverySource.diagnosisExcerpt: playerToken-in-URL exposes the auth credential in server access logs + browser history. Replace with short-lived preview nonce.

model.crossRefNote: R19.75 (token passthrough) is the MVP fix this hardens. R19.68 (room-scoped auth) is the gate. R19.76 replaces the long-lived token with a short-lived nonce — same auth semantics, no credential leakage.
